scripts.desktop:deb: pnpm run agent:build && tauri build --bundles deb
scripts.test: pnpm run agent:build && cargo test -p tomato-core -p tomato-agent -p tomato-todo && cargo build -p tomato-preview && pnpm run build && node --test tests/audio.mjs tests/integration.mjs tests/install.mjs tests/agent.mjs tests/agent-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:x11:app: pnpm run agent:build && pnpm run build && TAURI_CONFIG='{"build":{"devUrl":null}}' cargo build -p tomato-todo && node tests/x11.mjs --app
scripts.test:native: pnpm run agent:build && pnpm run build && TAURI_CONFIG='{"build":{"devUrl":null}}' cargo build -p tomato-todo && node tests/native.mjs
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && prettier --write src scripts tests package.json
scripts.check: pnpm run agent:build && tsc --noEmit && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check:handbook: python3 scripts/handbook-paths.py && python3 scripts/handbook-tests.py && python3 scripts/handbook-backlog.py && python3 scripts/handbook-stats.py && python3 scripts/check-handbook.py
